acquisition method: The mass spectrometer was operated in data dependent MS2 mode.
alkylation reagent: The reduced disulfide bonds were alkylated by adding 5.0 μL of 15.0 mg/mL iodoacetamide (IAA)
alkylation concentration: The reduced disulfide bonds were alkylated by adding 5.0 μL of 15.0 mg/mL iodoacetamide (IAA)
cleavage agent: Trypsin (Promega) was reconstituted in 50 mM ammonium bicarbonate
collision energy: selected for fragmentation using an isolation width of 1.6 m/z and a normalized collision energy of 17,500.
instrument: The fingerprint peptide samples were analyzed on a Thermo Scientific Q Exactive Plus high-resolution, accurate-mass (HRAM) mass spectrometer
ionization type: The LC eluent was ionized using a nanospray (NSI) source in positive ion mode.
labeling: data-dependent mass spectrometric analysis in which only the most abundant peptide precursor ions are selected for fragmentation and analysis.
reduction reagent: To the sample, 5.0 μL of 5.0 mg/mL dithiothreitol (DTT) in 50 mM ammonium bicarbonate was added
reduction concentration: To the sample, 5.0 μL of 5.0 mg/mL dithiothreitol (DTT) in 50 mM ammonium bicarbonate was added
